dedupe_keys.name: electronic files of shear wave velocity and cone penetration test measurements from the greater charleston area south carolina

description: Electronic Files of Shear Wave Velocity and Cone Penetration Test Measurements from the Greater Charleston Area, South Carolina is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ronald Andrus, Clemson University (clemson.edu). Electronic files of shear wave velocity (Vs) and Cone Penetration Test (CPT) measurements from 226 investigation sites in the greater Charleston area are presented in this report. Of the 226 investigation sites where shear wave velocity tests were conducted, 135 are sites where electronic files of CPT measurements are also available. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-fs8y-z482. Keywords: Charleston,  Cone Penetration Test, Earthquake, Liquefaction, Shear-Wave Velocity,  South Carolina. Published 2025-05-30. Facility named: Clemson University. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
